8 agents · 27 subtasks

Illustrative custody workflow responsibilities. The original synthetic trace retains its technical actor names and task IDs; this explanatory breakdown does not rename or overwrite those records.

Case Orchestrator
Register the failed-trade exception
Define the investigation scope
Consolidate the investigation evidence
Settlement Instructions Agent
Compare trade and settlement instructions
Validate security and quantity fields
Check the instructed settlement date
Compare delivery and receipt terms
Custody Position Agent
Confirm the custody holding
Check securities available for delivery
Identify reservations or encumbrances
Cash & FX Agent
Check the required currency balance
Confirm funding requirements
Check FX value-date alignment
Check payment cut-off times
Counterparty & SSI Agent
Confirm counterparty identity
Validate standing settlement instructions
Compare receiving account details
Check the instruction version in force
Messaging & Network Agent
Review settlement-message status
Identify missing acknowledgements
Trace rejection or failure codes
Reference Data & Market Calendar Agent
Validate security reference data
Check relevant market holidays
Check market and custodian deadlines
Supervisory / Materiality Agent
Rank evidence by materiality
Identify the issue requiring attention
Prepare a concise review summary
Original technical trace inventory · 8 actors / 27 task IDs

Listing a responsibility or task does not invoke an optional branch or establish an outcome.
